svg.title: Engineering Issue Desk investigation and recovery sequence
svg.desc: An engineer starts a case, the service persists its authority and budget, the Deep Agent alternates model calls with bounded reads, and immutable evidence is checked. An independent model audit precedes the human interrupt. Approval or rejection uses local state only; revision and explicit retry preserve cumulative case limits.
svg.text: Investigation and recovery sequence
Research may adapt; persistence, evidence checks, and review authority remain explicit • October 23 2026
Issue and explicit options
start and validate intake
Persist case and opt-in choice; lock, claim running, reconstruct cumulative usage
Invoke or resume inner thread
Adaptive loop with one shared case budget
Reserve model call → issue, context, available tools, and selected evidence
Tool requests or structured report with source and quote IDs
Reserve and validate read
Register literal snapshot
Evidence ID and quote spans
Bounded result or safe error
Tools may read the snapshot, approved provider pages, public GitHub, or explicitly enabled repository code. No code is executed.
Candidate report as JSON
Validate schema and resolve saved literal quote IDs; save unapproved draft
Separate budgeted evidence review: selected claims, proposals, and quotes only; no research tools
Strict indexed support verdicts → filter originals → revalidate citations
Save filtered report and audit; checkpoint human interrupt; status awaiting_review
Report, sources, safe events
Inspect evidence and decide
Explicit approve or reject through UI / CLI
Resume interrupt and save final local decision; no model call or external post
Revision branch
Human notes and prior report → new inner revision thread → research, citation checks, evidence review, and another human interrupt.
Up to two revisions; original case, registered evidence, and cumulative provider/tool limits are retained.
Failure and explicit retry
Safe failure leaves the draft unapproved. Retry resumes pending work; invalid completed output can use a fresh repair thread, at most twice.
OS lock recovery distinguishes abandoned runs from active sessions. Neither retry nor repair resets the budget. An AI audit is not human accuracy.
